failing_semantic_invariant: TMOV copies the source value version at execution time
minimal_reproducer: TCONST r0,5; TMOV r1,r0; TCONST r0,2; TRET r1
old_behavior: TMOV could record local_aliases[destination] = source and later resolve destination reads to the mutable source register
correct_behavior: TMOV reads source and writes destination residence and initialization state
why_repair_is_sound: It directly implements the value-copy contract and is independent of CFG, liveness, physical residence, spill, and call proofs
why_other_strategies_were_rejected: The existing local def-use information does not prove value-version immutability; a new value-version or SSA redesign would be disproportionate
